        "Read full one-path27-line config diff and current exact scope/hostname/issuer/lookup return branches plus actual CalDAV session caller. New caldav.fastmail.com maps to www.fastmail.com and FASTMAIL_SCOPES.caldav; CardDAV literal becomes existing FASTMAIL_SCOPES.carddav. CalDAV scope already exists before this patch; the missing service hostname mapping is added, not a new OAuth implementation/issuer/client.",

CalDavSession supplies actual channel host/type caldav and restricts token use to the obtained origin. A saved matching app-password login can disable OAuth first. Configuration does not force all users into OAuth or prove token reuse for every account.",
        "FASTMAIL_SCOPES property names describe service roles, and issuer www.fastmail.com differs from CalDAV hostname and api.fastmail.com endpoints. This is a scoped mapping/constant reuse, not a naming rule that every provider shares this structure. No config assertion or automated test changes; no login, token, provider network or calendar operation ran.",

Reporter proposes exact missing service-host mapping and existing scope constant; author reports local fix confirmation. Source proves adoption rather than inferring it from acceptance.",

Author local test/initial Daily claim and later Beta claim remain historical reports. Beta then ESR approvals/uplifts are distinct; mistaken assumption beta already had fix is corrected.       "observations": [
        "Read every hunk of all8 owned Rust files, actual authentication provider construction, original request loop/header caller and current shared sender/prompt paths. XpComEwsClient changes Credentials to RefCell and requires server to implement AuthenticationProvider plus UserInteractiveServer. Incoming implementation moves from reference type to server interface; outgoing provider moves from EwsOutgoingServer to nsIMsgOutgoingServer. Additional copy/move/create impl bounds follow that contract; they are not independent new retry algorithms.",
        "After an Authentication error in ReAuth mode, handle_auth_failure runs first; get_credentials and RefCell.replace run before RETRY/ABORT dispatch. Each request then derives a fresh header from current credentials. Refreshed password snapshot and per-request OAuth token acquisition are distinct operations. Silent authentication paths do not gain this interactive retry branch. Existing credential-ownership lesson is linked with exact current shared code instead of repeating its architecture claim.",
        "Owned cold-password branch bypasses the retry/new-password/cancel failure-choice dialog and prompts immediately when password empty; this differs from retrying an already failed stored password. Historical outgoing GetPassword searches login manager by ews://host and username, uses first matching non-null login or empty string. It does not establish outgoing retry/error-dialog repair. Current notify_password_failure has explicit prompt-cancel ABORT and confirmed-password RETRY; do not attribute that later distinction to this landing.",
        "Current fixed0b93 authentication is in protocol_shared, not the old Credentials/RefCell EWS design: Basic/NTLM delegate to Necko and optional OAuth headers are acquired per request. These are source phase comparisons. The current request comment mentions Basic as a possible direct header but actual provider returns None for Basic; follow receiver implementation, not that broader comment. No unsupported-NTLM or base64 Basic prescription is learned from historical code.",
        "No changed tests. Manual review: Rust trait bounds name both server capabilities, early guards preserve failure paths, comments explain why provider credentials must refresh even for later requests on same client. API/result types and nsCString/nsString conversions stay concrete; source style is scoped Rust, not exported JS guidance. No auth, prompt, network, build, lint, retry or runtime test.",
        "Full primary Bug1976550 description/comments0–2 and D256967 creation-to-final timeline read; zero actual submitted inlines and summary edits. Historical password retry stale credentials versus different OAuth flow preserved. Author explains interface move so server can supply AuthenticationProvider and UserInteractiveServer.",
        "Review first reports improved receiving but inconsistent no-password dialog and broken outgoing failure UX. Author adopts direct empty-password prompt, explicitly defers outgoing handling toBug1978594 to keep scope; reviewer accepts and removes outgoing test parts from separate test patch. Do not infer outgoing repair or linked test coverage from approval. Follow-up1978594 and other dependency pages stay unread.",
        "Author gives manual O365 normal-password steps comparing Authorization headers across intentionally failing requests and says automated tests will be separate. Those steps were not executed here; remote build events and historical reviewer reports are not fresh validation. No changed test in the exact8-file owned diff."
